# Claims Payment Rules

## Direct Vendor Payment

Direct payment to a mitigation vendor requires a signed assignment of benefits, a current W-9, and supervisor approval.

If any direct-payment authority document is missing, issue payment only to the insured and required mortgagee unless a claims manager approves an exception.

## Mortgagee Protection

Coverage A dwelling payments must include the mortgagee listed on the declarations when the payment includes building repairs.

Mitigation invoices may be paid separately only after direct-payment authority is verified.

## Review Escalation

Direct-payment requests with missing tax or assignment documents must be routed to adjuster review before payment release.
